L16.why: geometric series a=5, r=3: 5+15+45+135+405+1215 = 1820; 1215 is the last term, 3645 the next term, 364 the sum with a=1. Only 1820 is a sum, and the other three are exactly the three classic near-misses of that sum

L17.why: 0.51 repeating = 51/99 = 17/33; 51/990, 51/100 and 17/30 are the standard repeating-decimal distractors. 17/33 is the only fully reduced value consistent with the family

L18.why: 54, 108, 216 form a geometric run and 108 is the middle term; 24 is the stray. Middle-of-run heuristic only

L19.why: guess — -15/15 sign pair plus 9 and 29, nothing decides it

L22.why: guess — 44 is the magnitude outlier; 16/18/30 undifferentiated
